question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e. **'Typically'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word to fill in blank number 2 is option 3**: "typically".**
 
• In this context, **"typically"** is used to indicate what is usual or standard.
 
• **It suggests** that, on average or in most cases, rats are 5 inches or longer.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: * 'According to the Integrated Taxonomic Information System (ITIS) there are more than 60 species of rat, which means they come in all sizes. They are **typically** 5 inches (12 centimeters), or longer, according to Encyclopedia Britannica. The largest species is the Bosavi woolly rat, which was (3)______ in 2009 in the rainforest of Papua New Guinea (and doesn't have a scientific name yet). It is (4)_____ the size of a cat - 32.2 inches (82 cm) from nose to tail and (5)______ around 3.3 lbs. (1.5 kilograms), according to CNN.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options do not fit as well in this context:
 
 
• **"Modestly" **- This term is often used to describe something that is not large or elaborate. In this context, it does not appropriately describe the size of rats.
 
• **"Manually"** - This term is typically used to refer to something done by hand or without the help of machines. It does not fit in the context of describing the length of rats.
 
• **"Surgically" **- This term refers to things related to surgery, or done with extreme precision, neither of which fits well in this context.
